final: {"prompt":"Create a square, edge-to-edge, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting: a speculative visual metaphor for cognition expressed entirely through paint. A broad field of smoky ultramarine and warm chalk white holds uneven concentrations of dense, restless marks. Near the lower left, compressed layers of aubergine, charcoal, and deep cobalt accumulate through scraped impasto, translucent washes, and short, interrupted brushstrokes. Thin flashes of acidic yellow and hot vermilion emerge between these layers, sometimes buried, sometimes startlingly exposed. Let rhythms gather, almost cohere, then dissolve into softer passages. Across the center, a sweeping disturbance of pale peach and electric lavender pushes against the darker paint without forming a recognizable shape. Reserve generous, irregular expanses of nearly bare ivory toward the upper right, with subtle staining and a few hesitant traces. Make the empty space feel active and unresolved. Vary the surface between thick ridges, dry-brush friction, feathered wet edges, rubbed-back pigment, and delicate veils. Balance urgent local activity with spacious quiet; allow revisions, interruptions, and submerged gestures to remain visible. Avoid a single focal point or tidy symmetry. The painting should feel searching, layered, provisional, and unexpectedly lucid, with no literal depiction of a mind or brain. Absolutely no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Show only the painting filling the entire square image: no frame, borders, wall, room, gallery setting, or signature."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
